import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Fix island label variant (strip whitespace)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Filter out out-of-range body_mass_g values (2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Convert year to numeric
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and calculate average body_mass_g
    # Only include male and female (drop null sex)
    df_clean = df[df['sex'].notna()]
    
    result = df_clean.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    
    return result
